approved_scope: Phase 2 study of exactly two independently tunable capacitors (one GND shunt and one fixed-path-bypassing non-GND bridge) with UL H2/H3 minimum 30 dB. This is not formal RF-F001 approval. Phase 3 remains paused.
description: Two independent 0–4 pF Q80 tunable capacitors: one shunt to GND and one non-ground bridge, not a main-path series element. 30 dB UL H2/H3 is the Phase 2 study threshold; nominal RF-F001 35 dB baseline remains unmodified.
validation_notes: Bridge branch endpoints both nonzero and marked role=bridge. Its non-series nature must be shown from the fixed graph (e.g. in parallel with L3 node2-node3); a main-path series IC capacitor remains unauthorized. Each 0–4 pF Q80. RF-F001 minimum 30 dB unchanged; formal 35 dB nominal target not changed. The 30 dB threshold applies only when RF-T003 is explicitly selected.
